questions: What should happen if the image file exists but cv2.imread fails to load it (e.g., corrupt file, unsupported format)? Should it raise an exception, return an empty plot, or something else?
Should the 3D histogram plot include axes labels, a title, or any other formatting (e.g., legend, grid)?
What is the expected behavior of the onpick function? Should it be called with specific arguments or return values, and how should pick events be enabled on the plot elements?
Should the function display the plot (e.g., via plt.show()) before returning, or only return the Axes object without displaying?
What color mapping should be used for each channel in the 3D plot? The reference uses ('b','g','r'), but is that fixed or can it vary?
Is the histogram computed for all three channels (B, G, R) as in the reference, or could it be for a subset (e.g., grayscale conversion)?
Should the function handle images with alpha channels (4 channels) or only 3-channel RGB/BGR images?
What is the expected range of the histogram bins? The clarification says 0 to 256, but is the upper bound inclusive or exclusive (i.e., [0,256) vs [0,256])?
